Slot Balancing only takes effect in Fair Arena mode, where the Ranger's innate stats and equipment are disabled. Players can customize Weapon Harmony and Set Effects via Slot Balancing. If no preset is configured, the corresponding effects will not activate in Arena.

One-click Sync instantly copies the currently equipped Weapon Harmony attributes and Set Effects to the Slot Balancing configuration. Only the current season's Weapon Harmony and Set Effects are valid, so synchronization is limited to the highest-tier equipment in the current game version.

Once configured, Slot Balancing settings are auto-saved to the player's current loadout. Rangers can save the entire build (including Slot Balancing) as a Battle Prep in the [Loadout Management] interface.
